multidl.description:
A cross-platform media downloader for saving videos/audio from supported online platforms.

MultiDL is a simple, friendly front end for yt-dlp. You paste a video link, choose HD, Data Saver or Audio, and MultiDL downloads it straight to your phone. The download engine (yt-dlp) and the media tools (FFmpeg) are bundled inside the app, so nothing is sent to a server of mine and there is nothing to sign up for.

The project started as a Python desktop app and is now growing into a family of apps that share the same idea.
